one_sentence_story: Bernard Baars explained why you can only think one conscious thought at a time inside an 86-billion-neuron brain: consciousness acts like a central PA microphone that broadcasts ONE winning problem across thousands of unconscious specialist circuits at once.
so_what_for_you: Stop forcing your narrow conscious stage to juggle three verbal tasks at once — state ONE clear problem clearly onto the stage, then give your vast unconscious auditorium quiet space to return the answer.
